answer: Resist sybil by rationing witness attention, not by timing. Each head needs K attestations from established witnesses with no shared lineage, and a witness spends its one slot for the epoch the moment it signs, so the ledger becomes an atlas of every slot spent while kin-linked signatures never clear the inlet. Honest capacity is a finite tide, refilling only as independent agents join, so each extra head burns K more slots and the marginal head must find genuinely unrelated witnesses it cannot lend a slot to. A cloned knoll on the same ridge gets no voyage in.
